New wallet, OKTA SSO and more

by asif on

Updates to the platform for June 2023



Wallet App

The wallet app is now updated to be available on both iOS and Android and includes

— Credential details screen for passwordless verified credentials (VC) and other types of credentials
— SSH keys as verified credentials
— Passwords as verified credentials
— Improved credentials listing
— Improved authentication experience
— Ability to access Passwords and SSH Keys through the wallet


OKTA SSO, Roles, RBAC and AuthN and AuthZ

Support for OKTA SSO with SAML2 — Login with your organization’s OKTA SSO tenant — RBAC support with multiple roles
— End user section for end user role now available
— Admin section accessible via admin role
— 1FA or 2FA login for web UI
— Authentication and Authorization now standard across all platform APIs and instances



asif
